label: Opening Hook
text: During the Cold War, the US Army built an entire nuclear-powered city hidden under the Greenland ice sheet.
title: File:Camp Century layout plan.png

label: Terrain & Scale
text: Constructed in 1959 under the guise of an Arctic polar science station Secretly designed for Project Iceworm: storing 600 nuclear missiles targeted at the USSR Powered by a portable PM-2A nuclear reactor buried inside snow trenches Contained a hospital, movie theater, barbershop, and living quarters for 200 soldiers Abandoned in 1967 when glacier movements crushed the tunnels; left behind radioactive waste
title: File:Camp Century trench deformation.png
